description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the Thunder::Core namespace, providing an interface for shared, process-wide cyclic buffer management, including locking, reading, writing, and buffer administration.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class facilitating shared cyclic buffer operations across process boundaries, including locking, reading, writing, and buffer management.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: A helper class for navigating and peeking into the cyclic buffer data.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(const string& fileName, const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cyclic buffer with a filename, mode, size, and overwrite flag.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(Core::DataElementFile& buffer, const bool initiator, const uint32_t offset, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cyclic buffer with an existing data element file.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Acquires system-wide lock for buffer access, optionally waiting for data presence.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer, destructive operation that advances the tail.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer, advancing the head.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for upcoming write operations.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Virtual method called when data becomes available.
